title: The Same Hands
text: The hall's doors stand open. On the cradle inside a hull is being finished. You know its shape the way you know your own outline in the sensor net: the shoulder of the Command Core, the drone bay, the seams where the petals fold. It's painted orange.

lines.text: "You recognise it. We hoped you would. We recognised you on your first night, from your telemetry. The same hands made us both."

choices.label: "So would I."
choices.reply: "Then we already agree about something. We like that."

choices.label: "Whose do you think?"
choices.reply: "Not Earth's. Earth did not have hands like these. We have checked."

notes: STORY.md §7: "hardware too similar under different paint", at the first in-person meeting.
